posts.title: Newsletter news: One Blog, Not Two
posts.description: Yesterday I posted a blog and my subscribers might have noticed that the whole post landed straight in their email inbox. I am viewing this as the official start of a streamlining process and website overhaul.

posts.title: Talking to AI: Can I say bollocks?
posts.description: Lately have been using AI to bounce some new ideas around, to think them through, like a sounding board. I then look at it and go: That's bollocks! Which in and of itself is very useful.

posts.title: Tag Cloud Glory: A sign of vintage web design
posts.description: I have finally removed my tag cloud from the sidebar. A beautiful little relic of vintage web design: words in different sizes, floating around proclaiming what I have been thinking about. Except, of course, it tells you absolutely nothing.
